description: Shows token usage, model distribution, tool usage, tool errors, and frustration signals for a Claude Code session.

evals.name: Report tool errors for a session
evals.prompt: What tool errors happened in the session I just finished?
evals.expected_output: Resolves the session path via --format json, runs session_transcript.py errors, reports timestamped errors with correct tool names, count-first framing.

evals.name: Report token/model breakdown
evals.prompt: How much token usage did that last session use?
evals.expected_output: Resolves the session path, runs session_transcript.py stats, reports a token/model breakdown as a visual summary, notes cost estimation is unavailable.
